sentence_1_it: Un canarino è un piccolo uccello e la gente talvolta lo tiene come animale domestico.
sentence_1_en: A canary is a small bird, and people sometimes keep it as a pet.
sentence_2_en: I often receive letters from him.
sentence_3_it: Mio nonno talvolta parla tra sé e sé quando è da solo.
sentence_3_en: My grandfather sometimes talks to himself when he's alone.
